publisher.name: Erebrus AI
publisher.description: Curated local AI models for private inference on phones, laptops, desktops and nearby Erebrus workspaces.

catalog_policy.default_quantization_policy: Prefer Q4_K_M for balanced quality unless a model has a native or specialized quantization.
catalog_policy.vision_policy: Vision entries include their required mmproj artifact where the selected llama.cpp package uses one.
catalog_policy.mobile_policy: Mobile compatibility is a device-tier recommendation, not a guarantee. The app should perform a RAM and backend capability check before enabling download.
catalog_policy.download_policy: All artifact URLs point to public Hugging Face repositories. Pin revisions and mirror only after license review.
catalog_policy.integrity_policy: New production variants use immutable repository revisions, exact Content-Length values and independently computed SHA-256 checksums. Legacy entries remain unavailable to the verified package installer until their null integrity fields are resolved.
catalog_policy.runtime_policy: Every entry remains erebrus_runtime_verification=pending until tested with the exact runtime shipped by Erebrus AI.

device_tiers.label: Mobile
device_tiers.description: Modern phones and tablets; prefer models below 4B.

device_tiers.label: Flagship Mobile
device_tiers.description: High-memory recent iOS or Android hardware; experimental large and low-bit models may run.

device_tiers.label: Laptop
device_tiers.description: CPU, Apple Silicon or integrated/discrete GPU laptops.

device_tiers.label: Desktop
device_tiers.description: Desktop CPUs, Apple Silicon systems and workstation-class machines.

device_tiers.label: GPU Heavy
device_tiers.description: Systems where GPU offload is recommended for responsiveness.
